newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR LEADS QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR LEADS QUIET TRADE.

text.p: quiet week of trade on the Lusaka Stock Exchange, which saw a
marginal increase in traded volume over the previous week,
They said volume rose to 124,099 shares valued at 1,564,795
kwacha, slightly up from 112,388 shares worth 1,303,446 kwacha
Zambia Sugar gained three kwacha to end the week at 15
kwacha, and saw nine trades with a volume of 85,000 shares
Chilanga Cement remained steady at 55 kwacha and saw two
trades with a volume of 73 shares worth 4,015 kwacha.
Farmers House fell 61 kwacha and saw one trade with a volume
of 300 shares worth 71,700 kwacha, while Rothmans fell one
kwacha to end the week at 34 kwacha in one trade with a volume
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) saw no trades.
